newsitem.title: CHINA: China nickel firm output to hit 40,000 T in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China nickel firm output to hit 40,000 T in 1997.

text.p: A major nickel production base in northwestern China's Gansu province is planning to run at full capacity in 1997 and produce an annual 40,000 tonnes of nickel, an official of Jinchuan Nonferrous Co said on Tuesday.

The mine and production complex had completed its 2.3 billion yuan ($277 million) second phase expansion, which has allowed a doubling of its nickel production from 20,000 tonnes before the phase began, the official told Reuters by telephone.
The company planned to produce 38,000 tonnes of nickel in 1996, he said, although he added there were numerous obstacles to be overcome before output actually reached that level.
The company's nickel output totalled 33,000 tonnes in 1995.
The Jinchuan plant accounts for 88 percent of China's total nickel output, the official said.
